fields.label: Enable Mobile Attendance
fields.description: Master switch for app check-ins. A company also needs an enabled Mobile Attendance Company Policy, and each employee the Online or Offline box in the Mobile Check-in section of their Employee record.

fields.label: Enable Offline Sync
fields.description: Employees with Offline Check In save punches on the phone and upload them later; each becomes an Employee Checkin at its original time. The company policy must also allow offline. Only ordering conflicts wait for HR review.

fields.label: Enable Face Recognition
fields.description: Lets HR enroll employee faces and use Test face match. Record employee consent before enrolling.

fields.label: Face Match Threshold
fields.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0.2 to 0.9). Raise it to reduce wrong matches; tune with Test face match on real staff photos.

fields.label: Face Match Margin
fields.description: The best employee must lead the next one by at least this much (0 to 0.3), otherwise the result is ambiguous.

fields.label: Enable Supervisor Face Check-in
fields.description: Users with the MAAS Attendance Supervisor role can check in employees of their own company by face, from an approved phone. Scanned employees still need Online Check in.
